title: Qibnaytiino gexak naharal qunxa maabitina
intro: Caylale mirac kee fidin qibnaytiino elle xayyowtah tan golo fanah gexak, qunxa safar abeeni inkih tan ayyunta catah yan maabitina yaceeh yan taswiir. bohoy addat yan ayyunti reebuk gufa wak, qawwalayla taturta. too maabitinah derret yanbulle muuci baxissuh afkanitte kataya.
clues: Anu qunxa gineenit fantaaxaw le miraaciini amoytiinul.
Yi ummatta elle mannowtam golol addat tan buxaaxi, nek numuk teyni gersi marah seecam duuda.
Nanu too mirac kee mirac lih safarta qande bohoy foocal lino.
Anu inni ummatta sinni buxaaxih addat akah culan innah seeca num kinniyom kee aaxige kal axce waytaamih taagah nee takkaawisa.
Amoyti Sulaymaanaay, yi samad kay amrih gubat daffeyte gineenit fanat yan.
Anu woo goloh xuune kinniyo; yi maabitinah lakal, nanu ninni buxaaxi culleeh, akkewaytek nee tibbixeh sugtem aaxige kal.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Ayyunti cattiimeh kah kinnim qande widirih tuduure
Ayyunti amoytiini cokmih buxal axawat beenih yenen.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
